text:
lucy_sales: customer (healthtech EU org) wants a 10-day EU-only POC to validate traffic and key residency for an upcoming RFP. they explicitly prefer not to purchase Dedicated up front. can we support and what do we tell procurement?
owen_se: short: Hosted supports tenant-level region affinity but it's not a cryptographic residency guarantee. we can run a timeboxed policy that forces prefer-eu routing and enables audit logs for verification.
mira_ops: operationally: we can create a temporary routing policy that pins the tenant to eu-west-1 capacity and disables cross-region fallback for the POC window. steps: create policy, enable netflow and KMS region audits, run monitoring for all egress. note: this is manual and requires on-call signoff.
lucy_sales: useful. will procurement need pricing delta for Dedicated vs Hosted for strict guarantees?
ownen_se: ballpark: Dedicated (reserved pool) typically ends up 2.5-4x per-unit vs hosted, depends on commit level and model family. we can offer a lighter regional reservation for some customers (monthly minimum) that's cheaper than full Dedicated; ops must confirm availability.
dan_legal: contract note: for Hosted we can provide a 'preferred region processing' clause and commit to the scoped POC terms. we cannot warrant zero cross-border processing in Hosted. for guaranteed in-region-only processing, customer must use Dedicated or Private with BYOK/HSM and specific KMS controls.
lucy_sales: they also asked about sub-processors and whether any logging or monitoring tools replicate outside EU.
mira_ops: current EU sub-processors: cloud-provider-eu, metrics-eu (observability), logs-archive-eu. some vendor consoles are multi-region for availability; we can export and hand them EU-only artifacts for the POC. we'll provide the sub-processor list and a small annex.
lucy_sales: timeline: can we start the POC in 5 business days?
mira_ops: yes — but needs a support ticket and infra approval to flip the manual routing toggle. i can request a slot; expect a start in 3-5 business days.
deploy-bot: ticket RD-POC-621 created and assigned to @mira_ops; target start 5 business days.
lucy_sales: perfect. any wording we should use for the RFP Q asking "How do you ensure data processed only in EU?"
ownen_se: suggested: "Redwood provides tenant-level region affinity in Hosted deployments and can implement timeboxed operational policies to constrain routing during POCs. For contractual and cryptographic guarantees of in-region processing, Redwood offers Dedicated or Private deployments with customer-managed keys (BYOK/HSM) and on-prem/VPC options"
dan_legal: i'll draft a one-paragraph RFP response and attach the sub-processor annex.
lucy_sales: i'll send the customer's questionnaire here when it arrives. thanks team :thanks:
